name: Hailo-15H

flops.basis_detail: Hailo-15H product page states '20 TOPS (Tera Operations Per Second) running on a powerful' neural core for vision AI.

notes:
REAL VENDOR: Hailo (Tel Aviv, Israel). Set to 'asic-other' because the schema enum does not include 'hailo'. Hailo-15H is an AI vision processor SoC designed for mid-to-high-end smart IP cameras, combining image signal processing (AI-powered ISP) with a 20 TOPS INT8 deep learning neural core. Typical power consumption is rated at sub-5W (<5W). The SoC requires external DRAM with a published minimum requirement of 2GB LPDDR4. Software runtime support is provided by HailoRT and the Hailo Vision Processor Software Package, deploying models exported from ONNX and LiteRT (TFLite).
MEMORY FIGURES AND BANDWIDTH: STILL NULL, AND HERE IS PRECISELY WHAT WAS LOOKED FOR (2026-10-11). Hailo specifies a minimal DRAM requirement of 2GB LPDDR4 for camera systems utilizing the SoC, but the SoC itself contains no integrated VRAM package. Memory bus width and bandwidth depend on board implementation and are not published as a fixed silicon parameter. No numbers were assumed or back-computed.
